Hi André,

Thanks for writing, and sorry to hear your wife wasn't keen on it.

Your Bitfortun BS-4 left on October 27 and is already on its way to (address hidden). The tracking number is (number hidden) with Yun Express, and you can follow it here: (tracking link hidden)

Because the parcel is already in transit, the order can't be stopped at this point. Please do have a look at the unit when it lands. It's a quiet, compact miner and plenty of people warm to it once it's running, and if there is another product in our range you would prefer instead, tell me and I'll look at swapping it over for you.

If you'd still rather send it back after it arrives, just reply here and say so. This unit ships direct from the manufacturer, so a colleague will pick that up with them and come back to you by email with how the return is arranged. Please don't send anything back before we confirm the details.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Okey, can i send it back too you when i recieve it?

Sent with [Proton Mail](https://proton.me/mail/home) secure email.
Handed to the team · Dropship return cannot be opened with my tools; needs the manufacturer's return

Hi André,

Yes, you can send it back once it reaches you. Two things to keep it simple.

Please leave the box unopened if you can, or at least keep all the packaging and accessories, and don't plug the unit in. A unit returned complete and unused is the clean way to do this.

This miner ships direct from the manufacturer rather than from our own warehouse, so the return goes back to them and not to our usual returns address. A colleague picks that up today from 10am Eastern and will email you here with the return address and the label, so please wait for that before you send anything. If a parcel goes back on its own it can get lost in their system.

One other option, if you would rather keep the value with us: we can look at swapping it for something else in our range once it is back. Just say the word and I'll put the choices in front of you.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Okey, thanks for the help!

Sent with [Proton Mail](https://proton.me/mail/home) secure email.

Hi André,

You're very welcome. Nothing for you to do for now: keep an eye on the tracking, and the email with the return address and label will come to you here.

If you change your mind and decide to keep the miner after all, or you would like to look at swapping it for something else in our range, just reply here and I'll sort it out with you.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
